queries.result: First-party results identified the Bangladesh Department of Land Records and Surveys (DLRS) public Map Search, the DLRS map-purchase portal, and the Ministry of Land land-map project. These establish official national cadastral/map services, but the bounded search did not expose a Natore city parcel layer, safe parcel identity, or geometry in indexed results.

remainingUncertainty: The exact WUP point is preserved unchanged.
